question: Why did God tell Ezekiel to write down the date in Ezekiel 24?
options: It was the day Ezekiel became a prophet
The king of Babylon had laid siege to Jerusalem that very day
It was the day the exiles returned home
It was the day the temple was finished
explanation: God told Ezekiel to record the date because the king of Babylon had laid siege to Jerusalem that very day.
